g.title:
# $raw = gcb # copy qids from VALUES in Sparql
$parentQids = $raw -split '\r?\n' -notmatch '^\s|^$' -replace 'wd:(.*?)\s.*?(\d*)$','$1,$2' | fromCsv -delim ',' -hea q,limit $sparql = $parentQids | % { $parent = $_.q $limit = $_.limit ?? 10 @" { SELECT ?parent ?descendant ?links WHERE { BIND(wd:$parent AS ?parent) ?descendant wdt:P171+ ?parent . ?descendant ^schema:about/wikibase:sitelinks ?links . } ORDER BY DESC(?links) LIMIT $limit } "@ } | Join-String -Separator ' UNION ' | % { @" PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/> PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
SELECT ?parent ?descendant ?links WHERE { $_ } ORDER BY ?parent DESC(?links) "@ } $resp = Invoke-Sparql $sparql $qlwdqs
$qids = $resp.descendant -replace '.*/' | select -Unique $qids += $raw -split '\r?\n' -match '^\s' -replace '.*wd:(.*?)\s.*$','$1'
$qidsList = $qids | select -unique | % {"'$_'"} | Join-String -sep ', '
$cypher = @" MATCH path = ()-[:HAS_CHILD*]->(n) WHERE n.qid IN [$qidsList] RETURN DISTINCT path "@
# ======================== & java -jar $neo4jQuery @neo4jConnParams $cypher --id-property taxonID --include "scientificName,genericName,scientificNameAuthorship,labelRu,links,descendantsLinks,depth,rank,descendants,image,qid" > $outFile $graph = cat $outFile | fromJson -Depth 9
Add-ColorBasedOnGroup -Objects $graph.nodes -GroupBy rank -TargetPropName fillcolor Add-ImageInfo $graph.nodes $whiteListSubstring = 'gbif,britannica,catalogueoflife,bigenc,inatur,wikip' -split ',' Add-WikidataExternalUrls $graph.nodes $whiteListSubstring
$dotNodes = $graph.nodes | % {Get-DotNodeTaxon $_} | % {Get-DotNode $_ id} $dotEdges = $graph.edges | % {Get-DotEdge $_ source target}
$svg = ,"digraph { "+$dotNodes+$dotEdges+"}" | dot -Grankdir=TB '-Gnodesep=0.1' '-Ecolor=green:red;0.25:blue' -Gdpi=27 -Tsvg | Join-String -sep "`n" $graph.nodes | ? imgInfo | % {$svg = svgMergeImageUrl $svg $_.id $_.imgInfo.thumb} $svg = $svg -replace 'transform="scale\(.*?\)','transform="scale(1 1)' $svg = svgAddDescription $svg (gcb -raw) $svg > delme.svg; start .\delme.svg
